classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: sign_flip
classes.rationale: The operator that kills a `>= 0` bound and does NOT kill a `>= -1e17` bound — which is how ALR's five vacuous bounds become visible as a per-class zero rather than as an opinion.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: scale_error
classes.rationale: The sheet's unit is USD Million; a filer entering USD is the modal unit slip.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: off_by_one
classes.rationale: Boundary. Counts get ZERO tolerance — a person is not a rounded quantity.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: digit_transposition
classes.rationale: Keying error; survives a magnitude check, which is why a bound predicate cannot see it.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: zero_out_or_blank
classes.rationale: TWO operators, not one. `0` and blank are different facts, and `sum([]) == 0` is NC-Q01. A class that carried only one of them would make the two indistinguishable in the vector.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: round_to_integer
classes.rationale: The `tau(n) = 5n` straddle generator, and the source of `indeterminate.tolerance_straddle`. It produced all 22 of v0's 'equivalents'. COUNT is deliberately absent: rounding a count is not a rounding error, it is a different count.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: row_omission

operators.name: delete_row_values
operators.note: applied to every cell of one table row

classes.rationale: Where a missing investor or holding hides. A RANGE operator: it edits every cell of one table row, which is still exactly one worksheet part.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: row_duplication

operators.name: duplicate_the_value_above
operators.note: the cell takes the value of the cell one row up, which is what a duplicated row looks like cell-wise

classes.rationale: Double count; the tally identities exist for this.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: date_shift
classes.rationale: FME carries six date bounds. `DD<->MM` is the one a reader cannot see in a rendered date.

classes.citation: R. Abraham and M. Erwig, 'Mutation Operators for Spreadsheets', IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 35(1):94-108, 2009, pp. 97-100
classes.name: enum_substitution
classes.rationale: One LEGAL vocabulary term for another. A membership predicate CANNOT see this, by construction — it is a DESIGNED MISS and it belongs in the residue. A non-zero kill rate here would be evidence that something is wrong with the campaign, not that we are good.

classes.name: formula_override

operators.name: literal_over_formula_pair
operators.note: PAIR: the override plus a consistent input change, so the filing stays self-consistent and only TEMPLATE_DIFF can see it

classes.rationale: THE FLAGSHIP. A cell the pinned blank declares a formula for carries a literal. The pair form leaves the filing perfectly self-consistent because the inconsistency was deleted with the formula, and TEMPLATE_DIFF is the only thing in the design that detects it.

classes.name: vocabulary_drift
classes.rationale: MEASURED: one live regulated entity's registration number carries `U+2011 NON-BREAKING HYPHEN` — visually identical, byte-wise different, invisible in any screenshot.

classes.name: carry_desync

operators.name: move_both_ends
operators.note: PAIR: both ends of the carry move by the same amount, so every cross-sheet equality still holds and the number is wrong on both sheets

classes.rationale: 181 cross-sheet equalities on FME. This is the class they exist for, and the pair form is the coordinated-misstatement seed.

classes.name: vocabulary_gap_exploitation
classes.rationale: MEASURED: the regulator's template computes a scheme total with three COUNTIFs that between them MISS TWO of its nine legal Type-of-Scheme values. A filing exploiting that gap is undetectable by any relation the template encodes — P10's residue feedstock.
